facts.text: The party owes the wizard Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment for joining, offered in the form of Cedric's promissory note. It is unclear whether the note has already been handed over.
facts.uncertain_reason: The beats say the note was recommended for recruiting them, not whether it was actually given.

facts.text: Cedric's promissory note, which Dr. Uriah tallied at 975 gold pieces, promises three-quarters price for the party's treasure once the caravans flow again. It may already have gone to Malzazarik and Lady Hilda.
facts.uncertain_reason: Unclear whether the party still holds the note or gave it to the recruits.
